note: Sources approved 2026-09-09 for per-effort score-and-cost extraction. Provenance and reliability rationale: .scratch/delegate-redesign/research/2026-09-09-effort-data-sources.md

swerb.name: SWE Refactor Bench
swerb.caution: 20 tasks per configuration; execution provenance undocumented - nobody states who ran the 520 runs. Scaffold is pinned to exact CLI versions, which is why it stays in despite that.

aa.name: Artificial Analysis
aa.caution: Runs models in house. Use component scores, not the composite Intelligence Index, whose weighting is not published. One URL per model release page. Use the /models/releases/ pages, NOT /models/<slug>: the release page packs to ~480 lines and carries the effort sweep with $/task, while the model overview page packs to ~2960 lines and carries almost no cost data.

tbench.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
tbench.efforts: astra low..max; others at max only
tbench.caution: Scores an AGENT-MODEL PAIR, never a model alone. Public, internet-accessible task set with documented reward-hacking incidents. Rows live in the Next.js streaming payload, not the DOM - pack reaches them via the embedded extractor. The /2.1 path serves the same 4.0 payload; use the 4-0-0 URL. Earlier research citing 'Terminal-Bench 2.1' was reading a board that no longer serves its own data.

arc.name: ARC Prize (Verified board only)
arc.note: Not scraped. Read by hand for gpt-6-astra only, as a contamination cross-check: it is the one semi-private eval set among these. Community rows are vendor self-reports and must never be used.

rejected.cursorbench: Cursor grades its own Composer models on a proprietary harness tuned per model; no runner, tasks, licence or raw artifacts published.
rejected.databench: Hex, proprietary end to end, LLM-judged with acknowledged noise, no raw evidence released.
rejected.deepswe: Client-rendered with no data in the HTML; would need an API call, not a scrape.
rejected.swebench: Submission-based, no reasoning-effort field, no cost column, no catalog model by exact name.
rejected.vista: One selected effort per row; its own leaderboard states the ladders are not comparable.
